headline: Amazon renames Kindle Unlimited to Kindle+ with AI audiobooks
summary: Amazon rebranded Kindle Unlimited as Kindle+ (Kindle Plus), keeping unlimited access to its ebook catalog while adding a larger, AI-narrated audiobook selection.

claims.statement: Amazon has renamed Kindle Unlimited to Kindle+ (also styled Kindle Plus).

sources.quote: Amazon’s Kindle Unlimited is now Kindle+
Amazon renames Kindle Unlimited to Kindle Plus
Amazon rebrands Kindle Unlimited to Kindle+

claims.statement: The rebrand includes AI-narrated audiobooks via a Virtual Voice feature.

sources.quote: the audiobooks created with Virtual Voice in Kindle+ will instead be narrated by AI

claims.statement: The service continues to offer unlimited ebooks, comics and magazines for $11.99 a month.

sources.quote: will continue to offer unlimited access to a select collection of ebooks, comics, and magazines from the Kindle catalog for $11.99 per month

claims.statement: The service now includes a larger selection of audiobooks.

sources.quote: now includes a larger selection of audiobooks
